title: Reversals
coreMove: test a preference in both single and joint evaluation before trusting it
sourcePressure: shows that preferences can reverse when options are compared jointly instead of separately
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: calling reversals inconsistency only instead of seeing evaluation mode change salience

hook: opening with a named bias definition for Reversals
starting in a lecture hall or generic seminar
counterintuition: the obvious advice is simply slow down
smart people are immune if they know the term
tryThisNow: write three lessons in a journal
examples: student in a classroom guessing an answer
